per_example.claim: 中断可以暂停图执行，并等待外部输入后再继续。

dense.quote: This exception propagates up through the call stack and is caught by the runtime, which notifies the graph to save the current state and wait for external input.
The default graph.invoke(...) API still works and surfaces interrupts under result["__interrupt__"] .
When execution resumes (after you provide the requested input), the runtime restarts the entire node from the beginning—it does not resume from the exact line where interrupt was called.
